claim: Open Source alternative to newsletter tools like Mailchimp or Sendinblue; campaigns and sign-up forms; own inbox, AWS SES, Sendgrid, Mailgun, Postmark and SMTP
Self-host with Docker image pentacent/keila or sample Docker Compose; AGPL license
Requirements: container engine and a PostgreSQL database; reverse proxy must forward WebSockets
Visual editor, Markdown, plain text; MJML; segments; Liquid; form builder with captcha and double opt-in; API; tracking can be disabled
Hosted plans: XS 8 EUR per month, 2,000 emails per month; S 16 EUR, 5,000 emails
